mapper.sql: PAYMENT_ID, CONTRACT_NO, PAY_AMT, PAY_METHOD, EMP_ID, GLOBAL_TX_ID, PAID_DT
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_CTR_PAYMENT WHERE CONTRACT_NO = #{contractNo}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(PAY_AMT), 0) FROM TB_CTR_PAYMENT WHERE CONTRACT_NO = #{contractNo}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_CMS_DEBIT WHERE CONTRACT_NO = #{contractNo} AND STAT_CD IN ('10', '20')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_CTR_PAYMENT (CONTRACT_NO, PAY_AMT, PAY_METHOD, EMP_ID, GLOBAL_TX_ID, PAID_DT) VALUES (#{contractNo}, #{payAmt}, #{payMethod}, #{empId}, #{globalTxId}, #{paidDt})
